description.value: Peninsula Co-op Food Store at Keating is the sole full-service grocery supermarket operated by Peninsula Co-op, a 100% locally owned co-operative serving the Saanich Peninsula since 1977. With over 125,000 member-owners and a mandate to return profits to the community, it functions as both a major grocery destination and a community institution. Touring cyclists passing through the Saanichton area will find a full supermarket range here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Peninsula Co-op operates a single 'Food Centre (full-service grocery store) located in Saanichton' on Keating X Road, consistent with the OSM record at 2132 Keating Cross Road. The Contact Us page explicitly lists 'Food Centre 250.652.1188,' matching the OSM phone number exactly. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, camping fuel, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all amenity fields beyond basic groceries remain null.
concerns: Website footer address (Support Office, D-100 – 2261 Keating X Road, V8M 2A5) differs from the OSM store address (2132 Keating Cross Road, V8M 2A6); the footer address appears to be the administrative office, not the store, so no direct website confirmation of the store's civic address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active full-service grocery supermarket on the Saanich Peninsula — clearly useful to touring cyclists for resupply.

Basic groceries.detail: Website describes this location as a 'Food Centre (full-service grocery store)' — the co-op's only grocery store
